facts.text: Every student at Hillsdale College must complete a core curriculum that requires two foundation courses: 'The Western Heritage' and 'The American Heritage'.

sources.title: Adam Smith Award Acceptance Remarks - Imprimis - Hillsdale College
sources.quote: And so, Hillsdale has a core curriculum. Every student at Hillsdale is required to take two foundation courses—“The Western Heritage” and “The American Heritage
